_why: A breaker opens after 3 consecutive dead slots and blocks every later slot, and only a completed run (or an operator release) closes it, so nothing ever recovers on its own: on 2026-10-31 ten breakers had been open for 22 h to 8 days (stuck-work sweep). Half-open probe: after open_hours (times backoff_factor^probes, capped at max_interval_hours) release the breaker once so the lane's next natural slot is the probe; a RUN_DONE keeps it closed, a RUN_FAILED/RUN_TIMEOUT re-opens it at once (a release resets consecutive_dead, so without this the lane would fail three more times before re-opening). Coordinator 2026-10-31; operator: "validate all stuck agents and processes fix montior and make auto healings with claude code". Default off (§25.10.2).
